task.description:
WF-02, step 5 — write the tests of REQ-105 by the checked design docs/design/REQ-105-e2e-picker.md: the TEST-DESIGNER rows of section 3 and sub-steps 3 and 4 of section 14, in order, one sub-step at a time, each checked as its 'Red after it' column says before the next. Sub-step 3: the edits of section 12 rows 1 (the six names only), 2 and 3 in tools/test/e2e-kit.test.js (the prohibitions they guard are not weakened); tools/test/e2e-stand.test.js with E2S-01..E2S-20 (section 11.1); the fixture spec tools/test/fixtures/e2e-stand/specs/sleep-stand.e2e.js; after it `node --test test/e2e-kit.test.js test/e2e-stand.test.js` gives 72 tests, 72 pass. Sub-steps 4a-4c: tools/test/e2e/picker.e2e.js with the nine tests named as the criteria name them (matrix, pass, themes, keyboard, storage, isolation, not found, no connection, v3), and the SCANNED entry of section 12 row 1 made in the same change as the file (4a). Sub-step 4d: the independence loop of REQ-104 criterion 7 on picker.e2e.js (each name alone: exit 0, exactly one line that starts with 'ok ', and it is 'ok 1 - <name>'); the mutant series of section 16 applied on COPIES outside the project, never in the working tree, each with the test that catches it; the order check of section 13 on the two real files (smoke picker, picker smoke); `npm run check` at the end.

WHAT THE CODE STEPS CHANGED SINCE THE DESIGN — cover it, do not change the code: (a) O14: a stand that ended by itself before stop() fails with STAND_EXIT 'on its own' whatever its exit code; the stand-in mode quit-later (ends by itself with code 0 about 300 ms after the link) is covered inside E2S-11, no new id: wait for the fact isRunning() false (limit 5 s), then stop() rejects with STAND_EXIT holding 'exit code 0 on its own' and the log has no term; (b) gate remarks of the design: N18, E2S-13 asserts the event child-term in the log; N19, one case with a deps.spawn that throws at once (no pid: nothing registered, no signal, the marker removed, the error thrown at once) inside E2S-04 or E2S-02; N20, E2S-09 asserts the words 'after SIGTERM'; (c) the fixes of steps 04b and 04e, each inside the E2S test of its subject (no new ids, the counts of the design stay): a readyPattern whose one group takes no part in the match ends in URL_REFUSED with the stand cleaned up; in withStand a stop error that is the body's own error is not attached to itself, and a body error that cannot take a property is rethrown unchanged; an env value with a NUL is refused 'without NUL'; the timeouts accept 1 and 2147483647 and refuse 0 and 2147483648 with USAGE naming the range; a fake child that ends with close and no exit gets STAND_START_EXITED; (d) E2S-05 keeps two named allowances with their reasons, __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING (macOS adds it) and NODE_V8_COVERAGE (Node passes it on when the spec process has it), and the four leak names stay absent; (e) a fake child given through deps.spawn has real streams and sends exit and then close, as Node does (stop() waits for exit without a limit, a known Low).

RULES: the two sandbox flags and the skip words stand in none of these files, comments included (section 3); no sleep: wait for facts with limits, and a kill is followed by a wait for ESRCH, never one immediate check (decisions/0108 addendum, ISS-0103); each test runs alone; failure tests check that the state is unchanged. Report the duration_ms of `npm run -s e2e -- picker` (three runs) and of `npm run -s e2e`. If a test finds a real defect of the page or the server, do not weaken the test: stop and report it in result.issues with evidence (ORCH opens WF-03). Do not change tools/src, tools/test/e2e/kit/*, the stand-in, package.json. Task text and files hold no absolute machine paths and no names of the owner's other projects. Do not commit or push.

issues.text: Design section 8 row 6 (and criterion 6 of the block): 'B's questionnaire answer and B's result answer hold none of them' is false on the correct server when read as a substring test. Measured with the real server (<scratch>/e2e105t, a node script through startStand, before writing the test): uchet-pro -> svet-marketing: 49 texts of A only, and one of them, the unit «человек», stands inside svet-marketing's own questionnaire text; agency -> stock: 23 texts of A only, and the option label «Обучение» stands inside stock's own result for its leader set. Both are common words, not data of A. The test therefore checks the JSON answers by whole string values (no string value of B's answer equals a text of A) and keeps the substring test for the page text of B's card and for the solution names of A (multi-word names; 15 and 12, none shared with B, none a substring of B's answers, measured). A page or server that serves A's questionnaire to B gives A's texts as whole values: mutant P13 is red in isolation (and 6 more tests). For DOC-UPDATER: section 8 row 6 and 4.4 exclusiveStrings, and the wording 'hold none of them' of criterion 6 as an outdated wording; Q13 candidate (a substring oracle over short texts is false on common words).

N18 in the form the task gives (E2S-13 reads child-term after stop()) is a race on the stand-in as it is: the starter sends SIGKILL to the group as soon as the main process has ended, and the child may not have run its SIGTERM handler yet. Measured under load (6 full copies of the file and 8 loops of E2S-13 at once): 28 of 200 runs of E2S-13 alone and 1 of 6 full runs red with 'actual [] expected [<child pid>]'. Without changing the stand-in or the starter (task), E2S-13 now gives the starter, through deps.spawn (for the tests only, design 4.1), the real child whose 'exit' event is passed on only when the child has logged child-term or after 5000 ms: the final SIGKILL can only come later, never earlier, so S02 is still red (CLEANUP_FAILED) and S19 is red (no child-term, after the 5 s). After the change: 854 runs of E2S-13 under the same and a heavier load, 0 red (details in self_check). Consequence for section 16: S19 is caught by E2S-13, not a survivor; the only survivor of the design's list is S22. For DOC-UPDATER: section 11.1 E2S-13 and section 16 rows S19; Q13 candidate (an event that a child logs in a SIGTERM handler races the SIGKILL that follows the end of its parent: wait for the event before the starter may go on, never for a stretch of time).

A race of my own test, found by the stress run and removed before the series was rerun: startStand resolves at the first line that matches the pattern (for the picker the first link, svet-marketing), and the next lines can come in a later chunk of the pipe, so stand.stdout() right after the start may lack them: E2S-17 was red once in 8 full runs under load ('uchet-pro'). E2S-17 and E2S-01 now wait for the line as a fact (limit 5000 ms). After it: 40 full runs under load and 400 runs of E2S-13 and E2S-17 alone, 0 red. Not a defect of the starter (it promises the link, not the later lines). Q13 candidate: the start of a stand ends at its link, not at the end of its output.

Mutant P06 as worded ('a tenant id is looked up in lower case and accepts capitals') needs two edits: the lookup alone (my first form, P06a in the table) changes nothing a request can see, because the route refuses an id with capitals before the lookup (TENANT_ID of src/picker/limits.js, used by routeOf in request.js), and no test is red. The form that also lets the route take capitals is red in not found (/t/UCHET-PRO/ answers 200). For DOC-UPDATER and for TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR: section 16 row P06 names both places.

S22 (CLEANUP_FAILED no longer wins over STAND_EXIT, only that precedence changed) survives, as the design and decisions/0109 O13 record it (not testable with Node alone; REVIEWER read it). My first, wider form of it (STAND_EXIT before every other check, also before STAND_STOP_TIMEOUT, with a shorter message) is kept in the table as the own mutant T11: red in E2S-09, E2S-10, E2S-11, E2S-15, which pins the message and the place of STAND_STOP_TIMEOUT.

Test-side choices beyond the words of 11.1, all inside the write set and the design's intent, for DOC-UPDATER (section 11.1 rows): (a) E2S-02 also proves the two bounds of the timeouts are taken (1 and 2147483647 reach the spawn) and starts one real stand with both timeouts at 2147483647 in a child process (a timer that stayed armed would hold the test process for 24 days; in the child it turns E2S-02 red after 3000 ms instead, see S03 and S21); the refused options still spawn 0 times; (b) E2S-14 uses the same child helper; (c) every test stops its own stands in finally, so a test that fails half-way leaves no marker and no registration for the tests after it (in the first run of the series S05 and S07 turned 19 tests red by that cascade; now 3 each); a mutant that leaks a registered folder or group in the test process itself (S15, S20b, T02, T05, T08, T10) still turns the later tests red, honestly; (d) E2S-05 compares the exact environment the starter hands to spawn (a deps.spawn that records it and calls the real spawn) besides the names the child logs: the base names the parent has, the given names, a given LANG over the parent's.

Reading of criterion 4 'the element that holds the focus after every change of screen is inside the new [data-screen]': after a load or a reload the page leaves the focus on the body (F15, F17; it is the control 'the body has no ring'); the test asserts the rule on the changes made by keys (start, next, back, restart) and that the first Tab on the card lands inside [data-screen="card"].

Not mine and left alone: a folder sai-stand-test-lvEDJb of 2026-11-05 in the temporary root of the system (from an earlier step of this run; the LEFT check does not see it, its pattern is sai-e2e-), and the ten old processes (two 'node stand.js' with a working folder outside the project, eight 'node -e setInterval'). Every process this step started was ended by its pid or ended by itself; LEFT 0 processes and 0 sai-e2e- folders before and after every run.
